meta.title: Buddy Control
meta.description: Dispatch work to the local CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy agents, judge each result against acceptance criteria, send the rejections back into the same session, and repair the capabilities the worker was missing.

tools.buddy_run: Run one supervised attempt on the newest DeepSeek model.
tools.buddy_review: Accept the result, or reject it with revision directions.
tools.buddy_gaps: List the capabilities the attempt was missing.
tools.buddy_provision: Give the worker the missing plugin, MCP server or model.
tools.buddy_status: Fleet, pinned model, config drift and the run ledger.
